title: Trick or Take
tagline: Steal candy with friends in a 60-second Halloween browser game.
description: Compete in 2–6 player rooms to collect candy without getting caught. Optional Agora RTC voice chat lets friends talk while Agora RTM sends room-change notifications, backed by an authoritative Cloudflare Worker and D1.
author: zicojiao
